scope.summary: The old harness prints parsed JSON objects, but the supplied evidence does not establish whether the new print-depth checks are reachable through a supported target state or whether an equivalent route exists. Sufficiency remains unknown.

assessments.reason: The new array-printing guard rejects an output depth at the nesting limit. The harness prints only an object returned by parsing, and array parsing has a matching depth guard. The omitted parse dispatch and object-construction contracts are decisive to whether this behavior belongs to a feasible, uncovered printing state.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Array parsing enforces the same nesting-limit guard.
Printing dispatches array values to the changed function.

assessments.reason: The new object-printing guard rejects an output depth at the nesting limit. The harness prints only an object returned by parsing, and object parsing has a matching depth guard. The omitted parse dispatch and object-construction contracts are decisive to whether this behavior belongs to a feasible, uncovered printing state.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Object parsing enforces the same nesting-limit guard.
Printing dispatches object values to the changed function.

build.reason: The supplied build recipe delegates to fuzzing/ossfuzz.sh, whose contents are unavailable; the effective configuration and build cannot be established.

input.reason: The harness requires four selector bytes and a terminating NUL before passing the remaining C string to cJSON_ParseWithOpts, which measures that string and delegates to length-aware parsing.

evidence.dependency_reason: The called parser obtains the length of the NUL-terminated input.

lifecycle.reason: The harness frees printed output with free, while printing allocates through global_hooks. The supplied evidence does not show the effective hook initialization needed to establish allocator compatibility. Parsed objects are deleted on the normal path.

evidence.dependency_reason: Buffered printing allocates its returned output through global_hooks.
Unbuffered printing also returns memory allocated through hooks.
This is the cleanup called for the parsed object.

control_flow.reason: The harness reaches printing after a successful parse, and print_value dispatches arrays and objects to the changed functions. The omitted parse_value body prevents a complete trace from input bytes to those parsed node types.

evidence.dependency_reason: Parsing calls parse_value and returns the parsed item on success.
Printing dispatches array and object nodes to the changed functions.
